Before anything else, I heavily apologize for the loud keyboard audio. I did not do a sound check before I recorded this video, and I was not expecting this to be the first run of the recording, so I didn't have time to anyway. This issue will be fixed for my next speedruns of this category.

My first recorded run of Slime Rancher any%. The notable things about this run are the first Blanket split, the Gate split, and the Credits split. The rest are just down to practice and optimization. I lost about 40 seconds to food grinding before going out to pop the Phosphor and Honey Gordos, 30 seconds to not being totally confident I could make the Jetpack jump to Indigo Quarry, another 40-45 seconds to not making the Jetpack jump within a couple of tries in the Rock Gordo tunnel, and generally played slow in the Ancient Ruins and Glass Desert. That said, this is easily sub-19, but I believe with learning new tricks, practice, and studying, I can push this to sub-17 by the end of the week.

Massive time improvement since my last submission yesterday. Came from some tiny movement tech I picked up (thanks so much Famaro), and the overall capability of playing faster. I was able to for a few reasons; exposure to the run, and I spent almost an hour doing Vacpack 100% runs, and I became more confident with tending the ranch as a result, and it led to faster times, and here, a gold in my Personal Best (it's still pretty terrible.) However, I did lose time to warping home, my Phosphor is and will be really suboptimal for a while, some small mistakes / lack of risk-taking during the Honey Slime split, and finally, 30 seconds to not slime boosting properly to get into the tunnel in the Rock Gordo cave. I got a bit upset at this and still am, but overall, playing better in the rest of the run and some great price luck turned it around for me.
